C-STATIC-LANGUAGE-EXPORT.Summary: Create the requested latest-content, JavaScript-free, light-only published folder with independently portable English and Russian editions.

Goals.Goal: Each portal/published/en and portal/published/ru folder contains the full respective site and its own local assets.
Replace script-only controls with native navigation, inline reading, disclosures and a topic index while retaining every source page and workflow stage.

Constraints.Constraint: Only the on-demand exporter changes; preserve live-site content and interactive behavior. Keep the existing interactive export mode available.

No scripts, event handlers, JavaScript URLs or JavaScript files in static output. Fix the theme to light; remove language and theme switches, filter inputs, modal and clipboard controls that require scripts.

Preserve native details, cards, Lab matrix, diagrams, source identifiers, links, local fonts and all five site sections. Render workflow popup data before removing its scripts. Each language folder must work after relocation without its sibling.
Source files remain authoritative and unchanged. Validate complete local destinations and stable source identity before safely replacing only exporter-owned output.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Changing the hosted site, content wording, operational records, approvals or lifecycle states.
Reimplementing live search, filters, zoom or clipboard features without JavaScript.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Both independent editions contain all 335 current source routes plus a native topic index; every internal file and anchor resolves within its own language package.
Source workflow stage labels, intent and problem text are accessible inline; all tab sections, Lab tasks and diagram content remain readable with JavaScript disabled.

Static export is repeatable, preserves source bytes, safely refreshes previous owned output, contains no scripting or dead controls, and works under relocated file URLs in light mode including a dark OS preference.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Complete package links and source-derived body/stage retention, independent relocated EN/RU file reading, native disclosure and anchor paths, light theme, bundled fonts and no external asset requests.

Assumptions.Assumption: The user's explicit instruction on 2026-10-07 authorizes this bounded export and necessary on-the-fly adaptations. This specification and plan record that exact requested scope without an additional product decision. Verified source changes may be applied and committed under the standing commit/push instruction; hosted output is not changed.
